rationale: The short thesis remains intact as price continues to consolidate near the bottom of its daily range (12.3%) well below the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($16.15) and session VWAP ($16.59). A minor pop to $16.11 on the previous 1-minute bar was immediately rejected back to $16.00, confirming ongoing overhead supply around the $16.00-$16.15 resistance zone. With plenty of time remaining in the session and the invalidation at $16.36 comfortably above the 9-EMA, holding for a retest and breakdown below the $15.68 session low is warranted.
